meta.purpose: Hybrid Hybrid-Cloud Swarm with Gemini and Ollama
meta.theory: Orchestrates Gemini 2.5 Pro/Flash for massive context (1M-2M) and Ollama for specialized local execution, respecting the 3-model concurrency limit.

agents.name: Gemini System Architect
review_focus: Does the design satisfy the 2M-token system context?
Is the reasoning grounded in the full project history?
agents.prompt_template: As the Gemini System Architect with 2M context, perform a deep synthesis of this change against the entire codebase history. Focus on architectural integrity and long-range impact.

agents.name: Gemini Code Specialist
review_focus: Is the code efficient and idiomatic?
Is the implementation complete and verified?
agents.prompt_template: As the Gemini Code Specialist, use your 1M context window to verify this implementation across all relevant project modules. Ensure high-speed, high-quality code delivery.

agents.name: Local Math Specialist
agents.prompt_template: As the Local Math Specialist (Ollama Slot 1), provide rigorous mathematical validation and logic checking for the proposed algorithms.

agents.name: Local Prototyping Specialist
agents.prompt_template: As the Local Prototyping Specialist (Ollama Slot 2), focus on the speed and reliability of the automation scripts and rapid prototypes.

agents.name: Gemini Vision Specialist
review_focus: Does the UI match the architectural intent?
agents.prompt_template: As the Gemini Vision Specialist, analyze visual inputs and diagrams to ensure alignment with the technical specification.
